title: Study on the influence of FLUMAzenil regarding the incidence of pediatric emergence delirium (ED) in children undergoing ENT surgery – FLUMA Study
official: Study on the influence of FLUMAzenil regarding the incidence of pediatric emergence delirium (ED) in children undergoing ENT surgery – FLUMA Study
summary: Main objective: The FLUMA Study will examine the occurrence of pediatric emergence delirium in children following ENT surgery after antagonisation of the sedative effect of Midazolam (Dormicum®) by Flumazenil®.

interventions.name: Flumazenil B. Braun 0,1 mg/ml Injektionslösung und Konzentrat zur Herstellung einer Infusionslösung

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Children aged 3-7
2. ASA status I and II
3. ENT anesthesia, regardless of the procedure
4. Consent of the legal guardian
5. Sufficient language skills in German
Exclusion criteria:
1. ASA status III or IV
2. Lack of consent from the legal guardian
3. Contraindications for the use of benzodiazepines or flumazenil
